entities.name: Nikola Prkačin
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Nikola "Nikša" Prkačin is a Croatian retired professional basketball player and coach. At a height of 2.08 m tall, he played at the power forward and center positions. During his professional club playing career, Prkačin won seven European national domestic league championships, nine European national domestic cup titles, and one European national domestic super cup title, in 16 seasons.
